input.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$DesktopRoot = 'D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop'
$RootMcE = 'E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC'
$Kit = Join-Path $RootMcE 'Ava Laptop'
$src = Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'dist\win-unpacked'
$exeSrc = Join-Path $src 'Ava Ivy.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exeSrc)) { throw "Missing $exeSrc" }

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Kit | Out-Null
$appDir = Join-Path $Kit 'AvaIvy'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appDir) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $appDir -Recurse -Force }
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $appDir -Recurse -Force

# Also refresh D dist alias folder name for run-desktop.bat compatibility
$alias = Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'dist\AvaIvy-0.1.1-win'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $alias) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $alias -Recurse -Force }
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $alias -Recurse -Force

$startCmd = @"
@echo off
setlocal
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0Start-Ava-Laptop.ps1"
endlocal
"@

$startPs1 = @'
# Ava Laptop - boot brain + UI against E: RootMC (D twin fallback)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$Kit = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$Root = "E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Root "Web Files\rootmc-ava\package.json"))) {
  $Root = "D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC"
}
$AvaRoot = Join-Path $Root "Web Files\rootmc-ava"
$EnvFile = Join-Path $Root ".env"
$Exe = Join-Path $Kit "AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe"

$env:ROOTMC_ROOT = $Root
$env:ROOTMC_ENV_FILE = $EnvFile
$env:AVA_HANDOFF = Join-Path $Root "Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy"
$env:AVA_NO_STATUS_WINDOW = "1"

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $EnvFile)) {
  Write-Host "Missing secrets: $EnvFile"
  Write-Host "Finish copying RootMC\.env onto E: then re-run."
  Read-Host "Press Enter"
  exit 1
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $AvaRoot "src\index.mjs"))) {
  Write-Host "Missing Ava source: $AvaRoot"
  Read-Host "Press Enter"
  exit 1
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Exe)) {
  Write-Host "Missing UI: $Exe"
  Read-Host "Press Enter"
  exit 1
}

$node = "C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $node)) {
  $node = (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
}
if (-not $node) {
  Write-Host "Install Node.js 20+ LTS first."
  Read-Host "Press Enter"
  exit 1
}

$alive = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'rootmc-ava\\src\\(index|server|poller)\.mjs' }
if (-not $alive) {
  Write-Host "Starting Ava brain from $AvaRoot"
  Start-Process -FilePath $node -ArgumentList "src\index.mjs" -WorkingDirectory $AvaRoot -WindowStyle Minimized
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
} else {
  Write-Host "Ava brain already running (pid $($alive.ProcessId -join ', '))"
}

Write-Host "Starting Ava Ivy UI"
Start-Process -FilePath $Exe -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $Exe)
Write-Host "Status UI: http://127.0.0.1:8787/"
'@

$stopPs1 = @'
# Stop Ava brain + laptop UI processes
$ErrorActionPreference = "SilentlyContinue"
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" |
  Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'rootmc-ava\\src\\(index|server|poller)\.mjs' } |
  ForEach-Object {
    Write-Host "Stopping Ava pid $($_.ProcessId)"
    Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force
  }
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='Ava Ivy.exe'" |
  ForEach-Object {
    Write-Host "Stopping UI pid $($_.ProcessId)"
    Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force
  }
Write-Host "Done."
'@

$stopCmd = @"
@echo off
setlocal
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0Stop-Ava.ps1"
pause
endlocal
"@

$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
$exeInfo = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appDir 'Ava Ivy.exe')
$readme = @"
Ava Laptop kit
==============

Built: $stamp
UI:    Ava Ivy v0.1.1 -> AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe ($([math]::Round($exeInfo.Length/1MB,1)) MB)
Brain: E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava (Node)

Start
-----
Double-click Start-Ava-Laptop.cmd
  1) Starts Ava poller/server on http://127.0.0.1:8787/
  2) Opens AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe (Discord / Telegram + rewrite-before-send)

Stop
----
Stop-Ava.cmd

Needs on this laptop
--------------------
- Node.js 20+ ("C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe" or PATH)
- E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\.env
- E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava\ (+ node_modules)
- E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\scripts\lib\rootmc-env.mjs
- E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\

If E: transfer is still copying, wait until those finish, then Start-Ava-Laptop.cmd.
Falls back to D:\ twin if E: package.json is missing.

Do not run AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe alone unless the brain is already up
(rewrite falls back offline without :8787).

Rebuild
-------
powershell -File "D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop\scripts\build-laptop-kit.ps1"
"@

Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Kit 'Start-Ava-Laptop.cmd') -Value $startCmd -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Kit 'Start-Ava-Laptop.ps1') -Value $startPs1 -Encoding UTF8
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Kit 'Stop-Ava.ps1') -Value $stopPs1 -Encoding UTF8
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Kit 'Stop-Ava.cmd') -Value $stopCmd -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Kit 'README.txt') -Value $readme -Encoding UTF8

# Sync package.json / avaBridge / build script to E desktop tree
foreach ($f in @('package.json','lib\avaBridge.mjs','scripts\build-laptop-kit.ps1','README.md')) {
  $s = Join-Path $DesktopRoot $f
  $dst = Join-Path 'E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop' $f
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s) {
    $dd = Split-Path $dst -Parent
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dd)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dd | Out-Null }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $s -Destination $dst -Force
  }
}

# Update desktop README briefly
$deskReadme = @'
# Ava Ivy desktop

Windows UI for Ava chat panes (Discord / Telegram) with rewrite-before-send via local Ava :8787.

## Laptop kit (recommended)

Built kit lives on E:

`E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Ava Laptop\Start-Ava-Laptop.cmd`

That starts the Ava brain + `AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe`.

## Dev

```bat
cd "Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop"
start-ava-desktop.bat
```

## Rebuild kit

```bat
powershell -File "Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop\scripts\build-laptop-kit.ps1"
```

`signAndEditExecutable` is off so builds work without admin symlink privileges for winCodeSign.
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'README.md') -Value $deskReadme -Encoding UTF8
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'README.md') -Destination 'E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop\README.md' -Force

# Patch run-desktop.bat to prefer 0.1.1 then 0.1.0
$runBat = @"
@echo off
cd /d "%~dp0"
if exist "dist\AvaIvy-0.1.1-win\Ava Ivy.exe" (start "" "dist\AvaIvy-0.1.1-win\Ava Ivy.exe" & exit /b 0)
if exist "dist\win-unpacked\Ava Ivy.exe" (start "" "dist\win-unpacked\Ava Ivy.exe" & exit /b 0)
if exist "dist\AvaIvy-0.1.0-win\Ava Ivy.exe" (start "" "dist\AvaIvy-0.1.0-win\Ava Ivy.exe" & exit /b 0)
npm start
"@
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'run-desktop.bat') -Value $runBat -Encoding ASCII
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $DesktopRoot 'run-desktop.bat') -Destination 'E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava-desktop\run-desktop.bat' -Force

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== KIT READY ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host $Kit
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Kit | Select-Object Name, Mode, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Host '--- AvaIvy exe ---'
Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appDir 'Ava Ivy.exe') | Format-List FullName, Length, LastWriteTime
Write-Host '--- prerequisites on E ---'
@(
  (Join-Path $RootMcE '.env'),
  (Join-Path $RootMcE 'Web Files\rootmc-ava\package.json'),
  (Join-Path $RootMcE 'Web Files\rootmc-ava\node_modules'),
  (Join-Path $RootMcE 'Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\scripts\lib\rootmc-env.mjs'),
  (Join-Path $RootMcE 'Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy')
) | ForEach-Object { "exists=$([bool](Test-Path -LiteralPath $_)) $_" }
Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList $Kit
Write-Host 'KIT_DONE'

content.text:
Ava laptop kit is on E: and ready.

**Launch:** `E:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Ava Laptop\Start-Ava-Laptop.cmd`  
That starts the Ava brain (`:8787`) then opens `AvaIvy\Ava Ivy.exe` (v0.1.1, ~180 MB).

**Also in the kit:** `Stop-Ava.cmd`, `README.txt`

All E: prerequisites are already present (`.env`, `rootmc-ava` + `node_modules`, realm-api env loader, Ava Ivy handoff). Needs Node 20+ on the laptop PATH. Explorer should be open on that folder.
